Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side), PDF page 51: the slip of [[Tydirium (V) (Virtual Block 3) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“May deploy (with a pilot) without presence or Force icons. May add 2 pilots and 6 passengers. May forfeit a scout aboard to cancel all remaining battle damage against you here.”), word for word the text of [[Tydirium (V) (Virtual Block 3)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Master List (Light Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
